# Nile University of Nigeria

> Nile University of Nigeria is a leading centre of academic excellence, research and innovation in Abuja, and a member institution of the Honoris United Universities network.

## Admissions & Programmes

- [Undergraduate Courses](https://nileuniversity.edu.ng/undergraduate): Degree programmes across engineering, business, sciences, and the humanities.
- [Postgraduate Courses](https://nileuniversity.edu.ng/postgraduate): Advanced degrees for professionals and researchers.
- [School of Preliminary Studies](https://nileuniversity.edu.ng/sps): Foundation-year programme bridging secondary school and university, with direct entry into chosen degree programmes.
- [Tuition Fees](https://nileuniversity.edu.ng/tuition-fees): Fees for undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.
- [Scholarships & Discounts](https://nileuniversity.edu.ng/scholarships-discounts): Scholarships, sibling discounts, and sport scholarships.
- [Contact Us](https://nileuniversity.edu.ng/contact): Admissions, registry, finance, and student affairs departments.
